description: This file defines the DashletGeneric class, a base class for creating generic dashboard widgets in SuiteCRM. It includes properties and methods for configuring, building queries, processing data, and rendering a dashlet, along with handling user interactions and filter options.

classes.name: DashletGeneric
classes.description: A generic dashlet class for displaying tabular data with configurable filters, columns, and display options within SuiteCRM dashboards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with optional settings, sets up dependencies, and prepares the layout manager and list view objects.

methods.name: processDisplayOptions
methods.description: Prepares the configuration interface for customizing dashlet display options, including columns, filters, and search fields.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration interface for the dashlet.

methods.name: buildWhere
methods.description: Constructs the WHERE clause based on current filters and settings for querying data.

methods.name: loadCustomMetadata
methods.description: Loads custom dashlet metadata, such as search fields and columns, from metadata files.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs data processing, applies filters, and sets up the data for display in the dashlet.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet on the dashboard, including data display and auto-refresh handling.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves user-selected dashlet options like filters, display columns, and refresh settings from a request array.

methods.name: addCustomFields
methods.description: Adds custom fields to the columns array for display in the dashlet, if applicable.
